profile_requirements.notes: Existing scalar arithmetic, order, logic, sets, limits, and supported function symbols are exact.
The carrier is already exact but additional fixed OpenMath symbols are required.
Quantities, units, native geometry, data, or school probability need an explicit typed profile.
Scalar subfamilies are generic; native objects or application semantics need the school typed profile.
Existing generic and finite-graph slices are partial; relation, recurrence, matching, and coloring need a sibling profile.
Matrix and module carriers exist; basis, eigen, inner-product, and finite-dimensional map families require a dedicated profile.
Existing plane and complex profiles cover narrow slices; general incidence and transformation families need an extension.
Existing scalar and real-analysis profiles are partial; MVT, Taylor, integration, and series need an extension.
The current real-analysis profile is partial; metric, uniform, Riemann, and series families require an extension.
The existing profile is the base and requires sealed successor revisions for additional families.
The existing certificate profile is the base; solution, system, existence, and stability families require successors.
The existing finite/binomial slice is the base; conditional, continuous, asymptotic, and statistical families require successors.
Existing group, ring, ideal, and module slices are partial; quotient, action, field, extension, and structure families need successors.
The existing profile is partial and needs variable-modulus, CRT, quotient, and residue successors.
Loader-supported profiles cover only part of the advanced chapter target.
Sealed profiles exist but are not connected to the current local typed loader or runtime.
No complete current profile represents this chapter family.
